walkthrough.short: Face the way the ring is going and walk it in single file, one behind the other, holding nothing.
walkthrough.long: Turn to face the way the ring is going — {direction} — and walk round it in single file, each of you behind the one in front, with nobody holding anything at all. A quarter of the ring is one place along and a half is two. You stop still facing the way you were travelling, so whatever comes next is what turns you round. {where}

walkthrough.short: Walk half way round the ring in single file, one behind the other, holding nothing.
